task_description.overview: Cluster seismic events based on a precomputed dissimilarity (similarity) matrix and visualize the clustering as a dendrogram.
steps: Load the dissimilarity matrix from the provided NPZ file or URL.
Convert the condensed dissimilarity matrix to a square form if necessary.
Compute hierarchical linkage using a chosen method (e.g., single linkage).
Form flat clusters by applying a distance threshold criterion.
Visualize the results: plot the similarity matrix and generate a dendrogram with color-coded clusters.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Load the seismic event dissimilarity matrix from {dissimilarity_matrix_url}. Convert it to a condensed distance array if needed. Perform hierarchical clustering using the '{linkage_method}' hierarchy.linkage method. Apply a flat cluster cut at a distance threshold of {distance_threshold}. Finally, plot the similarity matrix and render a dendrogram with clusters color-coded by the same threshold. 
 Note: 1) Save the similarity matrix plot to {similarity_matrix_plot} and the dendrogram plot to {dendrogram_plot}.
